scripts.ios:generate: swift run --package-path Tools xcodegen generate --spec project.yml --quiet
scripts.ios:build: bun run ios:seed && bun run ios:generate && xcodebuild build -project ScentControl.xcodeproj -scheme ScentControl -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -allowProvisioningUpdates -quiet
scripts.ios:build:sim: bun run ios:generate && xcodebuild build -project ScentControl.xcodeproj -scheme ScentControl -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -quiet
scripts.ios:test: for p in ScentProtocol ScentMQTT ScentBluetooth ScentKit; do swift test --package-path Packages/$p || exit 1; done
